reviews.x: Ive bought many bath pillows and this one by far is the most comfortable. It also seems like it's the sturdiest. I will never buy a different bath pillow ever again!
An inexpensive, plastic-covered pillow with excellent suction. Dries easily, no apparent mildew/mold problem after several weeks use. Quite comfortable.

reviews.t: Helps sit up straighter in the bath!
reviews.x: I liked it!  I disliked nothing! 🙂. My boyfriend is very tall and has very long legs.  He is a DEA detective and his legs are always sore.  When I do epson salt baths,  this helps him sit up a little straighter so that his legs can straighten and be completely under water.  I’m so thankful I got it.  He Rolled his eyes about it at first but then appreciated after we tried it.

reviews.t: Comfy, durable, and easy to clean
reviews.x: Placed it on the tub months ago and the suction hasn't moved or slipped once. The material makes it easy to disinfect. Love the flexible crease between the pillows, makes it more comfortable with the bend of your neck.
Are use this every time I take a bath in my garden so it is comfortable and nice to have for relaxing baths.
Ordered this as a Christmas gift. Not super fluffy or soft but gets the job done
Seems well made and well designed. Great price!

Unlike inflatable versions I feel like this pillow was way more supportive than I have had previously.  I liked that it bent over the top of my tub, I feel like it cradles my neck and helps me relax just a little more.  I almost wish it had a terry cloth cover that would keep me from sticking too it just a bit, but that would be the only change.  I just threw a washcloth over it and that was fine.  If you have a soaker tub, you have to have this pillow.
I love this bath pillow. The quality is very good and I love the fact that it is easy to clean. My bath is one of my favorite places in my home and this bath pillow is a wonderful addition.

Easy to clean, fits my standard tub great and makes a bath that much nicer to take. I didn't expect much from it as I've bought bath pillows in the past that don't hold up. This one has and is easy to keep in the tub when taking a shower as it's thin but not so thin that it isn't comfortable.
I absolutely love this bath pillow. It works perfectly and makes my bath soooo much more comfortable. Would definitely recommend!
Suction cups are cheap and water is already gotten inside the cover! Cheap

I had to update my review because my cushion sprung a leak. The larger section, somehow water got inside and soaked the foam. I cut that part off carefully trimming the vinyl skin so as not to disturb the seam between the large section and the small (head rest) section. So now I have just the head rest which has two suction cups. It's all I really need anyway. Original review - My tub is a standard 60" with tile walls on three sides so I was looking for something minimal that would not take up m

I LOVE this bath pillow! It is so comfy to lean back & have a relaxing soak in the tub. This pillow is more comfortable than any I’ve tried before. I like that it has that flap for my neck to rest on. I love that it doesn’t absorb the bath water. I am careful about how I release the suction cups; I’m not sure if the material might tear if I just pulled them loose. That’s the only issue. It is totally fantastic as far as I’m concerned.

This pillow is large, soft, comfortable, simple - and the price can't be beat!!! I paid $10 for this, and other pillows that i was looking at, were twice the price and did not even look as good as this one!
Bought for a friend. She loves it. We went to severak stores searching for a bath pillow and found very small and poor quality ones for higher prices. This pillow is very comfortable while bathing
Suction cups stay put. Remove pillow from tub per instructions and it should last a long time. Just don't pull it off by the pillow or you will eventually tear the vinyl at the cup. Great value!

reviews.t: This is it for your tub!
reviews.x: Very comfortable and easy to attach to tub wall behind back.  No more sore back when taking a long soak.  Just lovely. Highly recommend
It does its job! Comfy, sticks REALLY well, and is easy to clean because it's just plastic.
Very easy to use and adapt to the shape of my bathtub.
I love this bath pillow,  very comfortable

reviews.t: this actually works exactly as advertised. Excellent product
reviews.x: I've finally found a product that actually works for the end of the bath tub. I don't know what masochist designed the original small uncomfortable bath tubs that seem to have been installed in nearly every home built since the 1960s.  This pillow really works, and its six suction cups allow for a lot of variation in placement. It stays in place and is very comfortable to use. It's waterproff and the suction cups come off easily with a little gentle prying.

Game changer for my nightly epsom salt baths. Before I bought this pad, I hated sitting in the tub for 20 minutes trying to get comfortable leaning back. It used to kill my neck and upper back.  So, I just leaned forward and just begged for time to fly by. This pillow is very comfortable. Instant relief! Now, I’m wondering if this thing will stay in place under water so I can put another one under my backside. That would be the ultimate.

reviews.t: Will not use any other bath pillow
reviews.x: I have owned three of these in 8yrs and will continue to order as needed. Suction cups last and it’s easy to wipe down. Would probably still be on my first one but I have children who get rough with it and have ripped the material while trying to pry the pillow from the tub wall rather than sliding the cups up until they release. Definitely recommend. Way more comfortable than traditional inflatable pillows.

These bathtub cushions have large suction cups to adhere to the top and inside of a tub. The "hinged" design allows the smaller top part to adhere to the top edge of the tub and the bottom to the inside of the tub. They tend to hold their position well and the padding is firm but comfortable. They hold up well over time. The first set we had lasted for years before the outside covering began to deteriorate.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the pillow as comfortable and relaxing for baths.
Many praise its sturdy, durable construction and strong suction that stays in place.
Several reviewers highlight that it is easy to clean and resists water/mildew.
Multiple reviewers consider it a great value for the low price.
A few reviewers report quality problems, including cheap suction cups and water leaking inside the cover.
